name: /invite-achiri command + file-based runtime alpha whitelist
goal: Three deliverables: (1) Replace static ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST env-var Set with checkAlphaAccess(chatId) that reads BOTH env var AND workspace/achiri/alpha-whitelist.jsonl at runtime — no bot restart needed when inviting users. (2) handleInviteAchiri() — owner-only /invite-achiri <chat_id> command: appends to alpha-whitelist.jsonl, returns confirmation. (3) Route /invite-achiri in index.ts + update handleHelp().
rationale: Apr 25 Achiri alpha launch (40d away). Current ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST is an env var read at startup — adding users requires SSH + pm2 restart. File-based whitelist lets operator invite via Telegram without server access. Critical for smooth Apr 25 alpha onboarding where operator will be inviting waitlist users one-by-one.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — checkAlphaAccess() + handleInviteAchiri()
tasks.description: Add ALPHA_WHITELIST_PATH = join(process.cwd(), 'workspace', 'achiri', 'alpha-whitelist.jsonl'). Add checkAlphaAccess(chatId: number): boolean — reads ALPHA_WHITELIST_PATH lines at runtime, returns true if chatId is in file OR in ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST env set. Replace inline alpha check in handleAchiri() (line 403: ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST.has(String(chatId))) with checkAlphaAccess(chatId). Add handleInviteAchiri(chatId, ownerChatId, text): owner-only; parse '/invite-achiri <target_id>'; validate target_id is numeric; check already invited; append JSON line {chatId, invitedAt, invitedBy} to alpha-whitelist.jsonl; reply '✅ Invited <id> to Achiri alpha. Whitelist now has N users. Run /waitlist list to see waitlist.' Update handleHelp(): add '/invite-achiri <id> — Invite user to Achiri alpha whitelist (owner)' under Achiri section.

tasks.title: index.ts — import handleInviteAchiri + route /invite-achiri
tasks.description: Add handleInviteAchiri to import from ./commands. Add case '/invite-achiri': await handleInviteAchiri(chatId, OWNER_CHAT_ID, text); in dispatch switch after /update-views case.
